nodes.label: --debug Flag Repurpose (plan)
nodes.rationale: Replace one-shot /game API dump with full loop + per-interval HUD state print. Avoids stopping the loop for debug inspection and gives real visibility into OCR output.

nodes.label: Debug Output Format ([DEBUG] lines)
nodes.rationale: Stdout is already piped to the log textbox in RunnerScreen, so debug output flows into the UI automatically without additional plumbing.

nodes.label: Banking Mode Toggle
nodes.rationale: Timed silence activated by global hotkey (Cmd+B) to suppress mineral/gas warnings when consciously saving resources. Auto-expires to prevent accidentally leaving on.

nodes.label: Smarter Contextual Detection
nodes.rationale: Game-phase awareness, post-fight cooldown suppression, and worker saturation rewards to reduce noise warnings. Requires game-state inference.

nodes.label: Post-Game Coaching Summary
nodes.rationale: Synthesizes existing game_stats warning counts into spoken/text debrief at game end. No new OCR needed.

nodes.label: Per-Race Coaching Tips
nodes.rationale: Race-specific warnings using the already-parsed race field. Requires separate message banks routed through get_message().

nodes.label: OCR Health Indicator
nodes.rationale: Green/yellow/red badge in GUI runner showing OCR parse reliability. Surfaces what game_api.py already tracks.

nodes.label: Warning Intensity Scaling
nodes.rationale: Scale warning urgency by severity (600/1000/1500+ minerals). Extends the tiered threshold system already used for supply to minerals and gas.
